title: The Tryouts of Cedar Falls
author: Beatrix Coldharbour
blurb: Ada Nakamura, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
